question: If multiple people view SCP-096's face at once, who will it attack first?
hypothesis: SCP-096 will attack the closest individual before targeting the others.
log: Ten Class-D personnel were positioned around SCP-096 at different distances. All subjects were instructed to look toward SCP-096 at the same time. SCP-096 became distressed and entered an enraged state. It attacked the closest subject first before pursuing the remaining subjects. MTF was deployed and recontainment was completed.
results: Distance appeared to influence the initial target, but SCP-096 continued targeting the other subjects.
research_notes: Current test data suggests distance may affect the first target selected by SCP-096. More controlled testing is required before this can be considered a reliable behavior.
conclusion: The hypothesis was confirmed. SCP-096 initially targeted the closest individual before pursuing the remaining subjects. However, additional controlled-distance testing is required to determine whether distance consistently determines the first target.
scientist_note: Hypothesis confirmed. Further controlled-distance testing is recommended.
